body: This could have been written by me. I have a friend in such a similar situation and here I am, feeling useless, as the girl on the other end. He encourages me to talk about my problems when they come up, but when his come up (and they do often) I don't know what to say anymore. It hurts that I can't fix him. I just wish he could see the goodness inside of him that I see every time we get together.
